basic_details.job_title: Department of Fisheries Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Young Professional and Senior Cyber Security Consultant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Department of Fisheries has notified 4 contract vacancies for Senior Cyber Security Consultant Grade-2 (Team Lead), Young Professional (Network), and Young Professional (NIC Application Support) posts. Qualifications vary by post, requiring a B.Tech or MCA with relevant experience as specified in the official notification. Selected candidates will receive a pay of Rs. 1,45,000 for the Team Lead post and Rs. 70,000 for Young Professional positions. content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The Department of Fisheries proposes to engage four (04) individual consultants on a contractual basis for providing specialized technical services in IT infrastructure and the cyber security cell. The post-wise breakdown of vacancies is detailed below:

rows.post_name: Senior Cyber Security Consultant Grade-2 (Team Lead)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must meet the essential educational qualifications, experience, and certification criteria prescribed for each specific post:

rows.post_name: Senior Cyber Security Consultant Grade-2 (Team Lead)
rows.essential_qualification_and_experience: B.Tech. (CSE/IT/EC) or MCA with 8–10 years of relevant experience in Cyber Security. Must possess at least one globally recognized professional certification such as CEH, CISSP, or CISM, and have a minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience in the Central Government and/or Central Public Sector Undertakings (CPSUs/PSUs). Requires Technical Administrator Course/Training Certificate (TM Apex Central/ Apex One/SC-200) and minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in deployment, administration, configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and management of Anti-APT solutions, EDR, XDR, threat intelligence integration, malware analysis, and incident response.

B.Tech. (CSE/IT/EC/EIC) or MCA with 3 years of relevant experience in Network. Must possess at least one globally recognized professional certification such as CCNA or CCNP, and have a minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience in the Central Government and/or Central Public Sector Undertakings (CPSUs/PSUs). Requires hands-on experience in Cisco Enterprise Routers, Cisco Catalyst L2/L3 Switches, HP/Aruba Switches, Fortinet/Palo Alto/Checkpoint Firewalls, Proxy Solutions, Anti-DDoS Solutions, Enterprise Wi-Fi, Cisco Video Conferencing, TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, OSPF, BGP, Static Routing, VLAN, QoS, ACL, VPN, DNS, DHCP, and Network Monitoring Tools.

B.Tech. (CSE/IT/EC/EIC) or MCA with 3 years of relevant experience. Must possess at least one globally recognized professional certification, such as CCNA or CCNP. Requires essential skills in Government e-Governance ecosystem, NIC Applications, eOffice, MeghRaj Cloud, Linux & Windows Server basics, Database (MySQL/PostgreSQL/MSSQL), DNS & SSL Management, Digital Signature (DSC), Government Cloud Operations Support, Application Deployment, ITIL Incident Management, and Helpdesk Operations.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The initial engagement is for a period of two (02) years, and it is further extendable by one (01) additional year subject to satisfactory performance, continued functional requirement, and approval of the Competent Authority. In no case shall the appointment be extended beyond three years from the initial date of appointment. The monthly remuneration is Rs. 1,45,000 for Consultant Grade-2 and Rs. 70,000 for Young Professional posts, with necessary TDS deducted as per rules. No other separate monthly allowances, HRA, residential accommodation, CGHS, medical reimbursement, personal support staff, or transport facilities shall be provided. Annual review of remuneration allows for an enhancement of up to 5% (or up to 10% in exceptional cases of exemplary performance and policy contributions) upon recommendations of the Performance Review Committee.

content_sections.heading: Department of Fisheries Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The engaged consultants will perform specialized technical duties across IT infrastructure and cyber security cells, which include: Planning, implementing, operating, and continuously improving the cyber security posture of the Department of Fisheries. Managing and monitoring Security Operations Centre (SOC) activities, security events through EDR, UEM, SIEM, and SOAR tools, and investigating alerts. Conducting malware analysis, threat hunting, digital forensics, and incident response (DFIR). Administering enterprise network infrastructure including routers, switches, next-generation firewalls, proxy servers, anti-DDoS solutions, and wireless networks. Providing complete support for NIC-hosted applications and services such as eOffice, Bharat VC, email (@gov.in), Sandes, and MeghRaj cloud services. Providing end-to-end cyber security and IT infrastructure support during high-level government meetings, VIP events, PRAGATI, and interactions involving the PMO and Cabinet Secretariat.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Department of Fisheries Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application format provided as Annexure-II in the official notification. Fill out the proforma with accurate personal details, educational qualifications, experience, and global/training certifications. Prepare an updated CV in World Bank format. Compile supporting documents including educational certificates, experience certificates, Aadhar card, global/training certificates, and police verification. Send the completed application form along with your CV and scanned supporting documents via email to the Department at [email protected] on or before 28 October 2026 at 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection of the consultants will be done on the basis of a personal interview or talk conducted by a Consultancy Evaluation Committee (CEC). Only short-listed candidates will be called for the interview. Shortlisted candidates must produce their bio-data and original certificates for verification at the time of the interview. No TA or DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in Department of Fisheries Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 4 vacancies are available under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit applications?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 28 October 2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Senior Cyber Security Consultant Grade-2?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Cyber Security Consultant Grade-2 (Team Lead) post is up to 50 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly remuneration for Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration for Young Professional positions is Rs. 70,000.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications in the prescribed format along with their CV and supporting documents through email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. Are these positions permanent government jobs?
faq.answer: No, these positions are filled purely on a short-term contractual basis initially for a period of two years, extendable by one additional year.

faq.answer: Selection is based on a personal interview or talk conducted by a Consultancy Evaluation Committee for shortlisted candidates.
